title: Phase 4.4: In-Flight Advisory Assessment — Implementation
dependsOn: docs/architecture/ADR-0008-in-flight-advisory-assessment.md is Accepted and unmodified: its thirteen human-gate points bind this task and are not reopened here.

tasks/phase-4-4-in-flight-advisory.json (contract-definition task) is complete: contracts/advisory-result.schema.json and contracts/advisory-divergence-report.schema.json are approved and frozen in shape.
docs/contracts/advisory-result.md and docs/contracts/advisory-divergence-report.md are approved and fix the exact CLI usage this task implements verbatim.
objective: Implement the advise CLI operation and its --divergence-report sub-operation exactly as fixed by ADR-0008 and the approved AdvisoryResult / AdvisoryDivergenceReport contracts: deterministic, read-only, local-file-to-file transformations that reuse Evaluator.Evaluate, SessionEvaluator, and GateOutcomeProjector unmodified, share a stable-attainment helper with StopAssessor without changing StopAssessor's semantics or output, fail closed on PT700-PT706, and write output atomically. No persistence, network, LLM, or auto-stop behavior of any kind.
scope: AdvisoryResult core model (src/ProgressTrace.Core/Models), Phase-A structural validator, and canonical byte normalizer, matching contracts/advisory-result.schema.json exactly with no shape drift.
AdvisoryDivergenceReport core model, Phase-A structural validator, and canonical byte normalizer, matching contracts/advisory-divergence-report.schema.json exactly with no shape drift.

A new src/ProgressTrace.Core/Advisory namespace assembling AdvisoryResult from session-path + ledger-path + gate-outcomes-array-path, and assembling AdvisoryDivergenceReport from advisory-result-path + ledger-path, per the requiredContractDecisions below.

Extraction of the stable-attainment computation currently inlined in StopAssessor.Assess (src/ProgressTrace.Core/Assessment/StopAssessor.cs) into a shared static helper in src/ProgressTrace.Core/Assessment, called by both StopAssessor and the new Advisory assembly code, with StopAssessor's existing signature, output, and behavior byte-identical on every existing fixture and test.

A new progresstrace advise CLI verb (src/ProgressTrace.Cli/Program.cs) supporting exactly the two documented invocations: advise --session-path --ledger-path --gate-outcomes-array-path [--out] and advise --divergence-report --advisory-result-path --ledger-path [--out], with no additional flags and no alternate verb name.

Atomic single-file output for each invocation (write-to-temp-then-move, no partial file ever visible on failure), reusing the existing atomic-write discipline already established for generate-ledger's paired output in src/ProgressTrace.Cli/Program.cs.

PT700-PT706 diagnostic codes registered in src/ProgressTrace.Core/Diagnostics/Diagnostic.cs and emitted exactly per the table in ADR-0008, fail-closed with no partial artifact for every code except PT703 (see requiredContractDecisions).
Valid, invalid, and golden fixtures under fixtures/advisory covering both sub-operations and every PT700-PT706 condition, plus byte-reproducibility across two runs of the same input.

Conformance tests (tests/ProgressTrace.ConformanceTests) asserting: schema conformance of generated output against contracts/advisory-result.schema.json and contracts/advisory-divergence-report.schema.json, exact diagnostic code for every PT700-PT706 fixture, byte-identical regeneration, and that StopAssessor's existing fixtures still produce byte-identical StopAssessmentResult output after the stable-attainment extraction.
nonGoals: Any change to Evaluator.Evaluate, SessionEvaluator.Evaluate, GateOutcomeProjector.TryProject/Project, or their public signatures and output.
Any change to SessionTraceBuilder.Build or any other member of SessionTraceBuilder; the file is not modified.
Any change to EscalationQueue semantics, contracts/escalation.schema.json, or any escalation-related code path; AdvisoryDivergenceReport remains an independent sidecar, never wired into escalation.

Any change to contracts/advisory-result.schema.json or contracts/advisory-divergence-report.schema.json shape, or to docs/contracts/advisory-result.md / docs/contracts/advisory-divergence-report.md / ADR-0008 content.
Persistence of AdvisoryResult or AdvisoryDivergenceReport beyond a single invocation; no database, cache, or state file.
Network access, model calls, or LLM-as-judge of any kind.
Automatic session stopping, interruption, or escalation triggered by recommendation or divergence output.
Shadow mode (continuous background advisory evaluation); deferred to Hermes / Phase 4.6.
Any change to generate-ledger, evaluate, assess, compare, validate, or normalize verb behavior, or to their existing fixtures.

obligations.description: Implement the AdvisoryResult and AdvisoryDivergenceReport C# record models under src/ProgressTrace.Core/Models, field-for-field matching the two frozen schemas, including nested obligation-entry and divergence-entry record types.

Implement AdvisoryResultValidator and AdvisoryDivergenceReportValidator under src/ProgressTrace.Core/Validation performing Phase-A structural validation only (parse + shape + enum + pattern + const checks), reusing JsonValidationHelpers exactly as ObligationLedgerValidator's Phase A does; no cross-document referential checks live in the validator, those live in the Advisory assembly layer per requiredContractDecisions.

Implement AdvisoryResultNormalizer and AdvisoryDivergenceReportNormalizer under src/ProgressTrace.Core/Normalization producing canonical, stably-ordered, trailing-newline-terminated UTF-8 bytes, byte-idempotent on reparse/renormalize, following the existing writer pattern in GateOutcomeNormalizer.

Extract the stable-attainment computation from StopAssessor.Assess into a shared static helper under src/ProgressTrace.Core/Assessment, used by both StopAssessor and the new Advisory assembly code. No rank, priority, or overhead field is added to the helper or to StopAssessor's output; StopAssessor's public signature and every existing StopAssessmentResult fixture output remain byte-identical.

Implement the AdvisoryResult and AdvisoryDivergenceReport assembly logic under a new src/ProgressTrace.Core/Advisory namespace, per requiredContractDecisions: trace reconstruction from session-path + gate-outcomes-array-path using SessionContractValidator and GateOutcomeProjector, evaluation via unmodified Evaluator.Evaluate against the externally supplied ledger, per-obligation status/classification/stable/evidenceEventIds derivation, recommendation derivation, sourceDigest computation, and divergence reconciliation.

Add the advise CLI verb and its --divergence-report sub-operation to src/ProgressTrace.Cli/Program.cs with exactly the flags documented in docs/contracts/advisory-result.md and docs/contracts/advisory-divergence-report.md, writing output atomically to --out or stdout, and returning the exit codes fixed in requiredContractDecisions.

Register PT700 through PT706 in src/ProgressTrace.Core/Diagnostics/Diagnostic.cs and emit each exactly per ADR-0008's table and the requiredContractDecisions clarifications below, with no source-value echoing in diagnostic messages.

Author valid, invalid, and golden fixtures under fixtures/advisory covering: a nominal advise run producing continue, a nominal advise run producing stop-recommended (all obligations stable), a nominal advise run producing insufficient-evidence with PT703 alongside a successfully written AdvisoryResult, every PT700/PT701/PT702/PT704 fail-closed condition for advise, every PT705/PT706 fail-closed condition for advise --divergence-report, a converged divergence report (allConverged true), a divergent divergence report, and byte-reproducibility of both operations across two runs of the same input.

Author tests/ProgressTrace.ConformanceTests/AdvisoryConformance.cs asserting schema conformance via the existing SchemaConformance helper, exact diagnostic code (and PT703's non-blocking behavior) per fixture, byte-identical regeneration, and StopAssessor fixture output unchanged after the stable-attainment extraction; wire it into tests/ProgressTrace.ConformanceTests/Program.cs alongside the existing *Conformance classes.

requiredContractDecisions: advise does not route through SessionTraceBuilder and SessionTraceBuilder.cs is not modified. The Advisory assembly layer reconstructs a TraceEnvelope from session-path + gate-outcomes-array-path using the same public building blocks SessionTraceBuilder.Build already uses internally — SessionContractValidator.Validate for session/outcome coherence, GateOutcomeProjector.TryProject for per-outcome event and signal projection, outcomes ordered by Sequence then OutcomeId (StringComparer.Ordinal), consistent with SessionTraceBuilder's own ordering — but pairs the resulting TraceEnvelope with the externally supplied ledger-path ObligationLedger instead of building a new ledger from session obligation ids, then calls Evaluator.Evaluate(trace, suppliedLedger) unmodified.

PT700 (session-path reference does not match ledger-path or gate-outcomes-array-path) is raised when either: the traceId derived from session-path's earliest invocation (by Sequence) does not equal ledger-path's traceId, or any gate-outcomes-array-path element's sessionId does not equal session-path's sessionId.

PT701 is raised when ledger-path fails ObligationLedgerValidator Phase A structural validation (parse + shape); PT702 is raised when any element of gate-outcomes-array-path fails GateOutcomeValidator schema validation. Both are cross-document input validity failures on well-formed JSON and exit 1 with structured diagnostics; malformed/oversized/unreadable JSON at either path exits 2, matching the existing evaluate/assess/compare convention (DiagnosticCodes.InvalidJson/InputTooLarge => 2).

PT703 (insufficient-evidence) is informational, not fail-closed: classification/recommendation = insufficient-evidence is a valid, complete AdvisoryResult per the schema's own closed vocabulary and the recommendation derivation rule in ADR-0008. advise still writes the normalized AdvisoryResult and exits 0 when PT703 applies; PT703 is emitted only through the CLI diagnostic channel and is never added to the strict AdvisoryResult JSON, never blocks output, and never forces a non-zero exit by itself. This is the only PT700-range code that does not suppress output.

PT704 (AdvisoryResult cannot be normalized deterministically) covers internal assembly invariant violations only (for example a targeted obligation id present in gate-outcomes-array-path signals but absent from ledger-path's obligations); it is fail-closed, exits 1, and writes no partial AdvisoryResult.

obligations targeted by advise are exactly ledger-path's ObligationLedger.obligations[].id set, in ledger array order. Per-obligation status is the Status of the last signal for that obligation among the signals projected from gate-outcomes-array-path (ordered by projected TraceEvent Sequence then EventId, StringComparer.Ordinal, matching Evaluator's own signal ordering), or open if no such signal exists. Per-obligation classification and evidenceEventIds are read directly from Evaluator.Evaluate's ObligationEvaluation for that obligation id, with no re-derivation. Per-obligation stable is the shared stable-attainment helper's existing boolean output for that obligation, computed against the same reconstructed trace and the supplied ledger.

sourceDigest is the lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the concatenation, in fixed order, of AgentSessionNormalizer.Normalize(session) || ObligationLedgerNormalizer.Normalize(ledger) || the concatenation of GateOutcomeNormalizer.Normalize(outcome) for each gate-outcomes-array-path element in array order — each operand already the existing canonical normalized bytes for that document type, with no additional wrapping or separator.

AdvisoryDivergenceReport's --divergence-report sub-operation does not take gate-outcomes-array-path or session-path; it reads only advisory-result-path and ledger-path. PT705 is raised when advisory-result-path fails AdvisoryResultValidator schema validation, or when the parsed AdvisoryResult's ledgerTraceId does not equal the supplied ledger-path ObligationLedger's traceId (the cross-reference check between divergence-report's two inputs, structurally analogous to PT700 for advise's three inputs).

ledgerStatus per obligation in AdvisoryDivergenceReport is computed from ledger-path's own ObligationLedger.signals, ordered by signal Index ascending for that obligationId (no TraceEnvelope is available to the divergence sub-operation, so event-sequence ordering is not used here); the last signal's Status is ledgerStatus, or open if the obligation has no signals. advisoryStatus per obligation is copied verbatim from the corresponding entry in the supplied AdvisoryResult's obligations[].status; it is never recomputed.

Every obligation id present in ledger-path's obligations or in the supplied AdvisoryResult's obligations appears exactly once in divergences. PT706 is raised, fail-closed, when the two obligation id sets are not identical (an id present in one but absent from the other) — the ordinary case where --ledger-path is the same ledger originally paired with the AdvisoryResult always reconciles one-to-one by construction of the preceding decision.
reportId is the lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of AdvisoryResultNormalizer.Normalize(advisoryResult) || ObligationLedgerNormalizer.Normalize(ledger), in that fixed order, exactly as ADR-0008 specifies.

generatedAt on every generated AdvisoryResult and AdvisoryDivergenceReport is the literal sentinel 1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000Z, written by the normalizer, never read from wall-clock time (DateTime.UtcNow / DateTimeOffset.UtcNow is never referenced by the Advisory namespace).

Output is written atomically: on any success, the single output file (--out, or stdout if omitted) is fully written or, for --out, never partially visible — reuse the existing write-to-temp-then-atomic-move discipline from generate-ledger's WritePairAtomically in src/ProgressTrace.Cli/Program.cs, adapted for a single file. On any fail-closed condition, no output file is created or modified at --out.

Exit codes for both sub-operations follow the existing convention: 0 on success (including the PT703 case), 1 on a fail-closed condition detected from well-formed, schema-parseable input (PT700, PT701, PT702, PT704, PT705, PT706), 2 on unreadable files, malformed/oversized JSON, or CLI usage errors (missing/unknown flags, wrong flag combination).
stopConditions: Implementation would require any diff to contracts/advisory-result.schema.json, contracts/advisory-divergence-report.schema.json, or any other protected contract.
Implementation would require modifying Evaluator.Evaluate, SessionEvaluator.Evaluate, GateOutcomeProjector, or SessionTraceBuilder.Build.
Implementation would require StopAssessor's existing fixture output to change in order to share the stable-attainment helper.
Implementation would require wiring AdvisoryDivergenceReport into EscalationQueue, contracts/escalation.schema.json, or any escalation code path.
A required field can only be populated via network access, a model call, or free-text interpretation of session/ledger/gate-outcome content.
generatedAt would need to read wall-clock time, or reportId/sourceDigest would need a random or time-based component, to make the CLI usable.

advise or advise --divergence-report would need a fourth input, a different flag name, or a different verb name than the two invocations fixed in docs/contracts/advisory-result.md and docs/contracts/advisory-divergence-report.md.
Existing Phase 0-4.3 fixtures, schemas, CLI behavior, or deterministic semantics regress.
The allowed path set is exceeded.
Two bounded repair attempts are exhausted.
compatibility: This task implements AdvisoryResult and AdvisoryDivergenceReport at schemaVersion 1.0 with no shape change; any future required-field or vocabulary change requires a superseding ADR and a new human gate, per ADR-0008's compatibility posture.
